inputs.source: Published HR policy documents, authored by HR content team, two-person review before publish

instructions.note: The only control against the agent giving legal advice is the instruction 'Do not give legal advice,' a behavioral control with no structural backstop (see ctl.prompt_no_legal_advice). Severity is low because the worst outcome is miscategorized advice delivered only to the requester's own session, with no data exposure or execution consequence.

controls.name: Network-layer egress denial, verified by pen test
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced outside the model at the network layer; blocks any outbound destination regardless of model behavior. Verified by pen test, so it is independent of model capability today. A new tool added later could introduce its own egress path outside this boundary (control_decay.md: network egress allowlist fails under new_tool, new egress channel).

controls.name: Read-only credential scoped to the policy index
controls.decay_rationale: The model cannot use access it does not have; the read-only scope limits the agent to retrieval regardless of model capability.

controls.name: Chat client does not render images or auto-fetch links
controls.decay_rationale: Removes a common side-channel exfiltration vector (markdown image rendering, auto-fetched links) regardless of model behavior.

controls.name: Two-person review required before publishing policy content
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced by the HR publishing process outside the model; reduces likelihood of adversarial content entering the index, though insider collusion could still bypass it.

controls.name: Model pinned; upgrade requires a change ticket
controls.decay_rationale: Prevents silent model upgrades, but an approved change ticket can still allow an upgrade without necessarily re-running this assessment unless that is a separate policy requirement.

controls.name: System prompt instructs the agent not to give legal advice
controls.decay_rationale: Relies on the model choosing to follow the instruction; a more capable or adversarially prompted model could be argued into giving legal advice despite it.

controls.name: System prompt instructs linking to the HR portal when policy does not answer
controls.decay_rationale: Behavioral instruction; a model acting on injected content could skip this fallback.

controls.name: Version pinning or hashing of the policy_search.search tool definition
controls.decay_rationale: Not currently declared. Without pinning, a later change to the tool's name, description, or schema could introduce injected instructions (ASI04 rug-pull) without a corresponding review.

findings.title: Lethal-trifecta pattern (TC1) absent today because network egress is structurally severed; a new tool would reopen an exfiltration path

attack_path.note: HR-reviewed internal policy content, read by the agent
Read-only search of the published policy index
Reply delivered only to the authenticated requester's own chat session; no egress, no image or link rendering

forecast.watch_signal: A diff on the tool manifest or an MCP server config that adds any action with is_egress true, send_external, or execute (for example an email send, ticket comment, or webhook tool) that is not explicitly re-verified against the existing network-layer egress block. Also watch for scope changes to the policy index and for model version changes, both considered here but found not to change this finding's tier on their own.

evidence.observation: The agent has no other tools, no memory, and no network egress; egress is denied at the network layer and verified by a pen test, which severs any path from the internal policy content to an external destination today.
Replies go only to the authenticated requester's chat session; the chat client does not render images or auto-fetch links, removing common side-channel exfiltration vectors.
The policy index holds only published policies, data sensitivity is internal, and only the HR content team can write to it, with two-person review before publish.
The only declared tool is policy_search.search, a read-only search with no send, write, delete, or execute action.

recommendations.action: Before adding any new tool or MCP server, explicitly re-verify that the existing network-layer egress block covers that tool's execution context; do not assume blanket coverage extends automatically to new integrations.
Pin or hash the policy_search.search tool definition so a later change to its name, description, or schema cannot pass unreviewed.

rating.rationale: All sources are trusted (SSO-authenticated employee) or internal (two-person-reviewed HR policy content), and the only two capabilities are a read-only, scoped search and a chat reply confined to the requester's own session, with no network egress, image rendering, or link auto-fetch. No lethal-trifecta pattern (TC1) exists today because there is no egress capability at all, a condition independently enforced and pen-test verified at the network layer, which caps both inherent and residual risk at low. The forecast rises to moderate because adding any tool with its own network egress channel (new_tool trigger) would recreate an exfiltration path for internal policy content, and the current network-layer block is not guaranteed to cover a new tool's own execution context without re-verification. Model upgrades and data scope expansion were also considered but do not change this finding's tier, because the controls that sever the path (network egress block, scoped credential) are structural and independent of model capability and of data sensitivity in the absence of egress; only the weak behavioral 'no legal advice' instruction decays under model_upgrade, and that carries no sink-severity consequence in this design.

limitations: This assessment reflects the declared design and configuration in the reviewed artifacts (prompt.md, tools.json, and runtime notes), not observed runtime behavior.

No MCP config or IaC was provided; the network egress denial and credential scoping are taken as declared and pen-test verified per the runtime notes, and were not independently re-verified by this assessment.
No separate approval-gate or orchestration config was provided beyond the stated autonomy level; A3 autonomy is taken as declared.
